select_modules.title: Select modules
select_modules.description: Choose modules, entity filtering mode, and device grouping.

data_description.device_grouping: Flat = one HA device per module for parameters; connectivity stays on a separate module.connection child (via_device). Group by menu = child devices per stable parent menu key (via_device). Changing remaps device membership (automations/dashboards).
